mainEntity.name: Is an AI receptionist a real person?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Kaico's receptionist tells callers it is an AI on the call. It sounds conversational and it books the job, but it does not pretend to be a person.

mainEntity.name: What happens when a call is too hard for the AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good setup plans for it. On Kaico's line, the call details reach you in the call summary so a person follows up. Because a person in Tulsa writes the script around your shop, the hard cases you actually get are written into it.

mainEntity.name: Can a human answering service book appointments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some can, if you give them access to your calendar, and it is often priced as an extra. Ask how the booking reaches your calendar and what a booked call costs compared with a message.

It depends on how you are billed. A human service is usually per minute or per call with a bundle and overage, so the bill moves with your call volume. Kaico's AI receptionist is $299 a month flat. Our guide on answering service cost walks through the models.

mainEntity.name: Can I try the AI before deciding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Call (918) 359-2644 and talk to it as if you were a customer. Ask for a time, change your mind, try to throw it off.
